Sept. 4/94 United States Indian Service, Puyallup Agency, Tacoma, Wash. Aug. 25, 1894 Hon. D. M. Browning Comm'nd. Ind. Affairs Washington City, D.C. Sir, I have the honor to transmit herewith descriptive statement of children transferred to Carlisle Indian Training School on the 3d inst. A concurrence of circumstances has caused the delay. Very Respectfully, Your Ob't Servt Edwin Ecello U.S. Ind. Agent INDIAN OFFICE 33364 Inclos. No. 1 1894 (5-138.) CERTIFY that the above descriptive statement of pupils this day delivered to Miss Lydia M. Hunt to be transferred to The Carlisle Training School, is correct. Dated Payalulps Agency Wash Aug 3 1894 Calvin Dalls U.S. Indian Agent I certify that I have thoroughly examined the above-named children and have found them physically sound, and in my best judgment believe them to be mentally sound. Dated At Payalulps Agency, First day of Aug 1894 Philip B. Leavenworth Agent Physician.
